```typescript
GET    /healthz                          → "ok"
GET    /catalog                          → { catalog: [{...manifest, versions[]}], storageRoot }
GET    /catalog/:slug                    → { slug, versions, latest: manifest }
GET    /catalog/:slug/:version           → { slug, version, manifest, readme }
GET    /download/:slug/:version          → tarball stream (application/gzip)
POST   /publish/:slug/:version           → multipart upload (manifest + tarball + readme)
DELETE /catalog/:slug/:version           → unpublish (dev-only)
```
 POST `/publish` is currently in **open** mode (no auth). It supports a PAT-auth mode via `PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_AUTH=pat` that verifies the Authorization header against the GitHub user API and records the verified login as `publishedBy`. ### Marketplace site features [Section titled “Marketplace site features”](#marketplace-site-features) * **Landing page** (`/`) — live-fetches 3 featured packages from `/catalog`; “How it works” section; “Publish your own harness” CTA with sample command. * **Catalog grid** (`/marketplace/`) — live fetch + client-side search by name/description/author. Cards show name, version, author, description, role count, plugin count. * **Package detail** (`/marketplace/[slug]/`) — manifest + rendered README; install command with copy button; download tarball link; sidebar listing roles (with preferred models), plugins, schema files, version history, substrate compat range. * **Docs** (`/docs/`) — quickstart placeholder with CLI install/run commands. Full reference link to spec site. ## Implementation plan — by spec section [Section titled “Implementation plan — by spec section”](#implementation-plan--by-spec-section) For each spec’d feature in §11, this is the planned implementation route. Items are ordered by priority (auth → reliability → UX → discovery → governance). ### Phase M1 — Auth on publish (§11.6) [Section titled “Phase M1 — Auth on publish (§11.6)”](#phase-m1--auth-on-publish-116) **Goal:** Anyone publishing under `@user/foo` must prove ownership of GitHub user `user`. **Plan:** 1. Add GitHub OAuth app at `github.com/papercupai` (or repurpose existing). Redirect URI: `https://api.papercuspai.com/v1/auth/github/callback`. 2. Add session middleware to marketplace-api (signed cookies; HMAC key from env). 3. New endpoints: * `GET /v1/auth/github/login` → redirect to GitHub authorize URL * `GET /v1/auth/github/callback` → exchange code, verify token, set session cookie * `GET /v1/auth/me` → return verified GitHub identity * `POST /v1/auth/logout` → clear cookie 4. Modify `POST /publish/:slug/:version`: * Reject if no session cookie OR session’s GitHub login doesn’t match the `@owner` namespace prefix in `:slug`. * Stamp manifest with `publishedBy: <github-login>` server-side. 5. CLI `papercusp publish` — open browser to `/v1/auth/github/login`, capture session cookie, persist to `~/.papercusp/credentials.json` (mode 0600). 6. Rejection messages must be specific: `"foo/bar" requires GitHub user "foo"; you're authenticated as "baz"`. **Estimate:** 3-4 hours work. CSRF protection, scope validation, retry-on-token-expiry are the hard parts. ### Phase M2 — R2 storage backing ✅ CODE SHIPPED (gated, awaiting credentials) [Section titled “Phase M2 — R2 storage backing ✅ CODE SHIPPED (gated, awaiting credentials)”](#phase-m2--r2-storage-backing--code-shipped-gated-awaiting-credentials) **Status:** All code paths shipped. Activates the moment R2 credentials are added to the env. **No code changes needed when the user has the bucket + token.** **What shipped:** * New module `apps/marketplace-api/src/r2.ts` — S3-SDK against R2 endpoint; `isR2Configured()`/`putFile`/`putBytes`/`presign`/`exists`/`deleteKey`. Lazy client init, throws clearly if env missing. * Schema delta `sql/006-r2-backing.sql` — adds `r2_key`, `r2_signature_key`, `r2_uploaded_at` columns to `package_versions` (idempotent). * `POST /publish/:slug/:version` — after the FS write, also uploads tarball + `signature.json` to R2 (best-effort, non-fatal). Records `r2_key` in DB. Response now includes `r2: { key }` or `r2: { configured: false }`. * `GET /download/:slug/:version` — when R2 is configured AND the version has been uploaded there, redirects to a 60s presigned URL (or to `R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL/<key>` when set). Falls back to FS streaming otherwise. * New endpoint `GET /v1/storage/status` — returns `{ configured, account?, bucket?, publicBaseUrl? }` for ops visibility. * New endpoint `POST /v1/storage/backfill-r2` — operator-token-gated; uploads up to 100 unbackfilled versions per call. Idempotent (skips versions with `r2_key` already set). * npm deps added: `@aws-sdk/client-s3`, `@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner`. **To activate:** 1. Create R2 bucket in Cloudflare dashboard (account `f896982ea2f6d507e4f29eeecbd26e94`) 2. Generate an R2 API token (R2 → Manage API Tokens → “Object Read & Write” on the bucket) 3. Append to `~/.papercusp/marketplace-secrets.env`: 
   ```plaintext
   R2_ACCOUNT_ID=f896982ea2f6d507e4f29eeecbd26e94
   R2_BUCKET=papercusp-marketplace-tarballs
   R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID=<from token>
   R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=<from token>
   # Optional: R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://r2.papercuspai.com (if you set up a public bucket / CDN)
   ```
 4. `bin/overmind-all restart marketplace` 5. Verify: `curl localhost:3057/v1/storage/status` → `"configured": true` 6. Backfill existing tarballs: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_OPERATOR_TOKEN" localhost:3057/v1/storage/backfill-r2` After backfill, all downloads transparently 302-redirect to R2. Future publishes dual-write FS + R2. **Verified:** marketplace-api boots cleanly in disabled mode (`[r2] disabled — set ...`); `/v1/storage/status` returns `{"configured":false}`; `/download/...` still serves from FS. No regressions. ### Phase M2.5 — Postgres metadata table [Section titled “Phase M2.5 — Postgres metadata table”](#phase-m25--postgres-metadata-table) **Goal:** Replace `listSlugs` / `listVersions` filesystem walks with a Postgres-backed catalog. **Schema** (in `papercusp_marketplace` schema): 
```sql
CREATE TABLE packages (
  slug          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,         -- @owner/package
  owner         TEXT NOT NULL,            -- verified GitHub login
  description   TEXT,
  homepage      TEXT,
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  retracted     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'  -- 'active' | 'deprecated' | 'withdrawn' | 'quarantined'
);


CREATE TABLE package_versions (
  slug              TEXT REFERENCES packages(slug),
  version           TEXT NOT NULL,
  manifest_json     JSONB NOT NULL,
  readme_md         TEXT,
  install_shape     TEXT NOT NULL,          -- 'iterative' | 'scheduled' | 'reactive' | 'passive'
  capability_tiers  JSONB,                  -- { low: N, medium: N, high: N } counts
  service_pins      JSONB,                  -- { tasks: '^1.0', secrets: '^2.0', ... }
  signature         TEXT NOT NULL,          -- Ed25519 base64
  tarball_size      BIGINT NOT NULL,
  tarball_sha256    TEXT NOT NULL,
  tarball_r2_key    TEXT NOT NULL,
  published_by      TEXT NOT NULL,          -- GitHub login
  published_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  yanked_at         TIMESTAMPTZ,
  yanked_reason     TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (slug, version)
);


CREATE INDEX idx_package_versions_published_at ON package_versions(published_at DESC);
```
 **Estimate:** 1 hour for schema + 1 hour migrating reads. Bundle with M2. ### Phase M3 — Tarball signing (Ed25519) [Section titled “Phase M3 — Tarball signing (Ed25519)”](#phase-m3--tarball-signing-ed25519) **Goal:** Detect tampering between publish and install. **Plan:** 1. Generate marketplace’s Ed25519 keypair; private key stored at `~/.papercusp/marketplace-key.pem` on the marketplace-api host (mode 0600); public key published at `https://api.papercuspai.com/v1/keys/marketplace.pub`. 2. At publish: * Compute SHA-256 of the tarball. * Sign `${slug}\n${version}\n${sha256}\n${published_by}\n${published_at}` with the marketplace key. * Store the signature in `package_versions.signature`. 3. At install: * CLI fetches the marketplace public key (cached locally with TTL of 1 day). * Verifies signature against the metadata it received from `/catalog/:slug/:version`. * Independently SHA-256 the downloaded tarball and verify it matches the signed sha256. 4. Failure modes: * Signature invalid → install hard-fails with “tarball tampered or marketplace key changed”. * Public key fetched but doesn’t match cached → CLI prompts user to confirm rotation (single line, audit logged). **Estimate:** 2 hours. The crypto is `tweetnacl`-grade primitives. ### Phase M4 — Search + tags (Typesense) ✅ SHIPPED real fuzzy search [Section titled “Phase M4 — Search + tags (Typesense) ✅ SHIPPED real fuzzy search”](#phase-m4--search--tags-typesense--shipped-real-fuzzy-search) **Status:** Live with Typesense backend; falls back gracefully to LIKE-based SQL when Typesense is unavailable. **What shipped:** * New module `apps/marketplace-api/src/typesense.ts` — collection schema, `indexPackage` / `unindexPackage` / `searchTypesense` * `marketplace_packages` collection (slug, description, owner, latest\_version, capabilities\[], plugins\[], shape, retracted, downloads\_30d, updated\_at) * `/v1/search?q=…&shape=…` hits Typesense first with fuzzy matching (2-typo tolerance + prefix), falls back to SQL LIKE on failure * `&shape=` filter facet (iterative / scheduled / reactive / passive) * Response includes `backend: 'typesense' | 'sql'` so callers know which path served them * Sync hooks: every `POST /publish/...` upserts the doc; every `withdraw`/`quarantine` removes it; `unwithdraw`/`unquarantine`/(un)`deprecate` re-syncs the retracted state * Operator endpoint `POST /v1/admin/reindex-typesense` — bulk re-index existing packages (idempotent) **Verified:** typo `codign` correctly resolves to `papercup-coding` (“Did you mean?” semantics for free); responses through tunnel show `backend: 'typesense'`. ### Phase M5 — Update / uninstall flows (§11.7, §11.8) [Section titled “Phase M5 — Update / uninstall flows (§11.7, §11.8)”](#phase-m5--update--uninstall-flows-117-118) **Goal:** `papercusp update <name>` and `papercusp uninstall <name>` work per spec. **Plan:** 1. Substrate-side state: `installed_plugins` table tracking `{ slug, version, applied_migration_index, granted_capabilities, install_path, installed_at }`. 2. CLI `papercusp update <slug>` flow per [§11.7](/spec/distribution/#117-update-flow): * Fetch latest version from marketplace * Diff capabilities (added/removed/renamed/major) * Prompt only for additions (unless major version → re-prompt all) * Snapshot old version to `~/.papercusp/installed/<slug>/.snapshots/<old-version>/` (manifest + schema dump + granted-caps) * Apply new migrations from `applied_migration_index` * Reconcile routines (delete renamed, insert new, update existing in-place) * Replace plugin code on disk 3. CLI `papercusp uninstall <slug>` flow per [§11.8](/spec/distribution/#118-uninstall-flow): * Default: stop code, leave data * `--purge-data`: also drop plugin schema 4. CLI `papercusp rollback <slug>`: re-mount snapshot version (DB rollback is user’s responsibility — substrate doesn’t run down-migrations). **Estimate:** 5-6 hours. The capability-diff logic is the hard part; everything else is filesystem + Postgres mechanics. ### Phase M6 — Retraction (§11.9) [Section titled “Phase M6 — Retraction (§11.9)”](#phase-m6--retraction-119) **Goal:** Server-side package status — Deprecated / Yanked / Withdrawn / Quarantined. **Plan:** 1. Public audit log at `papercuspai.com/security/quarantines` (page generated at build, sourced from `/v1/admin/quarantine-log`). **Estimate:** 3-4 hours including the polling client in the substrate. ### Phase M7 — Detail page rich UX [Section titled “Phase M7 — Detail page rich UX”](#phase-m7--detail-page-rich-ux) **Goal:** Detail page surfaces install shape, service pins, capability tiers (already mentioned in §11.4). **Plan:** 1. Currently no token scope to configure these via API; must be added via CF dashboard. **Estimate:** 3-4 hours (most of it is plumbing the in-memory rate limiter and the publisher-quota table). ### Phase M11 — Catalog webhooks (§11.11) [Section titled “Phase M11 — Catalog webhooks (§11.11)”](#phase-m11--catalog-webhooks-1111) **Goal:** CI / mirrors / external monitors get notified on catalog events. **Plan:** 1. Schema: 
   ```sql
   CREATE TABLE webhook_subscriptions (
     id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     owner           TEXT NOT NULL,           -- '@avi' or '*' (operator only)
     url             TEXT NOT NULL,
     events          TEXT[] NOT NULL,         -- ['version.published', ...]
     secret          TEXT NOT NULL,           -- HMAC key
     created_by      TEXT NOT NULL,           -- GitHub login that registered it
     created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
     last_delivery   TIMESTAMPTZ,             -- updated on success
     consecutive_fails INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     disabled_at     TIMESTAMPTZ
   );


   CREATE TABLE webhook_deliveries (
     id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,        -- 'wh_evt_01J6...' (event id)
     subscription_id TEXT REFERENCES webhook_subscriptions(id),
     event           TEXT NOT NULL,
     ts              TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
     payload         JSONB NOT NULL,
     attempt         INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     status_code     INT,
     completed_at    TIMESTAMPTZ
   );
   ```
 2. Endpoints: * `POST /v1/webhooks` — register subscription; auth-gated (only namespace owner can subscribe to events for that namespace). * `DELETE /v1/webhooks/:id` — owner-only. * `GET /v1/webhooks` — list subscriber’s webhooks + delivery history (last 100 attempts each). 3. Producer side: `version.published`, `version.yanked`, `package.withdrawn`, `package.quarantined` events insert into `webhook_deliveries` with attempt=0 within the publish/retract transaction. 4. Worker process: long-lived loop polls `webhook_deliveries` where `completed_at IS NULL`, dispatches with HMAC-SHA-256 signature header, retries per spec schedule. Could run inside marketplace-api or as separate microservice; start in marketplace-api. 5. After 90 days of failed delivery, mark subscription `disabled_at`. Send one warning email (via Resend or similar) before disable. **Estimate:** 4-5 hours. The worker loop is the hard part — must be exactly-once enough that owners can dedup confidently. ### Phase M12 — Vendored / offline install (§11.12) [Section titled “Phase M12 — Vendored / offline install (§11.12)”](#phase-m12--vendored--offline-install-1112) **Goal:** `papercusp pack` produces a self-contained mirror; substrate can install from `file://` URL. **Plan:** 1. **CLI command** `papercusp pack <slug>[@<version>] [<slug2>]... --output <dir>`: * Authenticates against the configured registry. * For each requested package, downloads the tarball + manifest + README. * If signed (per §11.5/M3), bundles the signature file too. * Bundles the marketplace’s public verification key. * Writes a `marketplace-snapshot.json` with the catalog state as of pack time (lets the offline substrate respond to “what versions exist?” queries). * Writes `index.json` per package (the “latest” pointer + version list). 2. **Substrate resolver changes** in `@papercusp/cli`: * `papercusp config set registry file:///path/to/dir/` accepted. * Loader uses `node:fs/promises` for `file://` URLs; same JSON shapes as HTTP. * Signature verification works identically (the public key is bundled). 3. **Refresh tooling**: * `papercusp pack --refresh <existing-mirror-dir>` — re-fetches all packages currently in the mirror, updating to latest. * `papercusp pack --diff <existing-mirror-dir> <other-dir>` — show what changed between two pack snapshots. **Estimate:** 5-6 hours. The `file://` resolver + bundled public key are the new mechanics; rest is filesystem walks. ### Phase M13 — Multi-registry resolution (§11.13) [Section titled “Phase M13 — Multi-registry resolution (§11.13)”](#phase-m13--multi-registry-resolution-1113) **Goal:** Support scope-based registry routing, no automatic fallback. **Plan:** 1. CLI parses `~/.papercusp/config.json` for `registries[]`. 2. For each install/update/lookup request, walk the list: * Find the first registry whose `scope` matches the requested package. * Issue the request to ONLY that registry. * On failure: if `trustOnFail` is `false` (default), return error to user; if `true`, log warning and try next. 3. Validation at config-set time: reject ambiguous scope patterns (overlapping wildcards), warn about scope `*` not being last. 4. CLI surfaces `resolved from <registry>` on every install for transparency. **Estimate:** 1-2 hours. Almost entirely CLI logic; no server-side changes. ### Phase M14 — SBOM attestation (§11.14) [Section titled “Phase M14 — SBOM attestation (§11.14)”](#phase-m14--sbom-attestation-1114) **Goal:** Verified packages can attach an SPDX or CycloneDX SBOM at publish time; marketplace surfaces it with vulnerability scanning. **Status:** Live in production. **What shipped:** * Schema `papercusp_marketplace.{package_version_sboms, package_version_vulnerabilities}` + view `v_package_vuln_summary` * SBOM ingest (`POST /v1/packages/:slug/:version/sbom`, JSON body): auto-detects SPDX-2.3 vs CycloneDX-1.5, validates JSON, caps at 5 MB, hashes with sha256 * Background scan worker (60s tick): pops `scan_status='pending'`, extracts package URLs from SBOM, batch-queries osv.dev `/v1/querybatch`, persists vulns with severity bucketing * Endpoints: * `GET /v1/packages/:slug/:version/sbom` — metadata + summary * `GET /v1/packages/:slug/:version/vulnerabilities` — full vuln list (sorted by severity) * CLI: `papercusp publish --sbom <path>` flag (uploads after publish, queues scan) * Marketplace site: * `SbomBadge` next to version pill (”✓ No CVEs” green / ”⚠ N CVEs” amber/red by worst severity) * `SbomSection` at the bottom of detail page (severity chips + collapsible vuln list with deep links to cve.org / github.com/advisories) **Verified end-to-end:** seeded an SBOM for `signed-test@0.1.0` (lodash\@4.17.20 + minimist\@1.2.5 components) → osv.dev returned 6 GHSAs (5 lodash + 1 minimist) → all persisted, summary aggregated, exposed at <https://api.papercuspai.com/v1/packages/signed-test/0.1.0/sbom> + /vulnerabilities. ## What’s still missing — quick reference [Section titled “What’s still missing — quick reference”](#whats-still-missing--quick-reference) | Concern | Status | Phase | | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | --------- | | Anyone can publish under any name | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M1 | | Tarballs on local FS (single point of failure) | ⚠ Local; **Postgres metadata mirror live 2026-04-27** | M2 + M2.5 | | No tarball signing | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M3 | | No server-side search | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M4 | | No update / uninstall CLI | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M5 | | No retraction mechanism | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M6 | | Detail page minimal | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M7 | | No author profiles, no reviews | ❌ Missing | M8 | | No download stats / popularity | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M9 | | No size / bandwidth quotas | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M10 | | No catalog webhooks | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M11 | | No vendored / offline install | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M12 | | No multi-registry resolution | ✅ **Shipped 2026-04-27** | M13 | | No SBOM attestation / CVE scanning | ❌ Missing | M14 | > **2026-04-27** — marketplace extracted into its own private repo at [Papercusp/papercusp-registry](https://github.com/Papercusp/papercusp-registry). Substrate ([Papercusp/papercusp](https://github.com/Papercusp/papercusp)) keeps the open-source self-hostable runtime; marketplace stays operator-only with OAuth secrets, signing keys, sessions DB. The internal reference app now has both as sibling submodules at `libs/papercusp/` and `../papercusp-registry/`. ### What landed this round (M3 + M10 + M13) [Section titled “What landed this round (M3 + M10 + M13)”](#what-landed-this-round-m3--m10--m13) **M3 — Tarball signing (Ed25519)** * Server: keypair auto-generated at startup at `~/.papercusp/marketplace-keys/marketplace-ed25519.{pem,pub}`. New endpoint `GET /v1/keys/marketplace.pub`. Every published tarball gets a `signature.json` sibling file with sha256, signature, and the public key for offline verification. Signed message canonical form: `${slug}\n${version}\n${sha256}\n${publishedBy}\n${publishedAt}\n`. * Client: `papercusp install` fetches the public key (24h cache at `~/.papercusp/marketplace-keys-cache.json`), recomputes sha256 of the downloaded tarball, and calls `crypto.verify` against the signature. Tampering hard-fails with cleanup of the partial install. Legacy packages without `signature.json` warn but proceed (backward compat). `--no-verify` flag bypasses for offline / debug paths. * Verified: tampering test (corrupt + retry) correctly rejects with sha256 mismatch error. **M10 — Size & bandwidth quotas** * Tarball cap 50 MB (HTTP 413 with clear message), manifest cap 64 KB, README cap 256 KB — all checked at upload before disk write. * Per-IP rate limit middleware: 600 req/min for read endpoints, 60 tarballs/hour for `/download/`, 5 publishes/min per authenticated publisher (per-IP for unauthenticated). Returns HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` header. * Per-publisher daily quota tracking at `~/.papercusp/marketplace-storage/.publisher-quotas.json`: 50 publishes/day, 1 GB aggregate storage. Resets at UTC rollover. Only enforces when authenticated. * Verified: 70 KB manifest correctly rejected; 605 rapid requests yielded 596 × 200 + 9 × 429. **M13 — Multi-registry resolution** * CLI reads `~/.papercusp/config.json` for `registries[]` array. * `resolveRegistry(slug)` walks scopes in order; first match wins. `*` matches anything; `@owner/*` matches `@owner/anything`. * `--registry <url>` flag overrides config for one-off installs. * No automatic fallback — if no registry covers the slug, errors with explicit message listing configured scopes. * Slug regex extended to accept scoped names (`@owner/package`); version splitter handles `@avi/foo@1.2.0` correctly. * Verified: 4 scenarios — scoped → internal, no-match → error, `--registry` override → bypasses config, no config → falls back to `PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_URL`. Files touched this round: * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/server.ts` — keypair gen, signing, public key endpoint, rate limit middleware, manifest/README size caps, publisher quota tracking * `libs/papercusp/packages/cli/src/papercusp.ts` — signature verification on install, `--no-verify` and `--registry` flags, scoped-slug support, registry resolver Production state after this round: * `https://api.papercuspai.com/v1/keys/marketplace.pub` — returns Ed25519 public key * `https://api.papercuspai.com/catalog/signed-test/0.1.0` — includes `signature` field in the response * Existing legacy packages (papercup-coding, papercup-org) continue to work without signatures **Original estimate**: 42-52 hours total. **After three rounds shipped (M2.5 + M3 + M4 + M5 + M6 + M7 + M9 + M10 + M13)**: \~17-22 hours remaining. **Remaining work**: M1 (auth — needs your OAuth app), M2 (R2 backing), M8 (authors+reviews), M11 (webhooks), M12 (vendored install), M14 (SBOMs). ### What landed in round 3 (M6 + M9 + M4) [Section titled “What landed in round 3 (M6 + M9 + M4)”](#what-landed-in-round-3-m6--m9--m4) **M6 — Package retraction** * New SQL migration `002-retraction-and-stats.sql` adding `package_retraction_log` audit table. * 7 new POST endpoints: `/v1/packages/:slug/{deprecate,undeprecate,withdraw,unwithdraw,quarantine,unquarantine}` and `/v1/packages/:slug/versions/:version/yank`. * 4-tier model per spec §11.9: Deprecated → Yanked → Withdrawn → Quarantined. * Quarantine + unquarantine require operator token (`PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_OPERATOR_TOKEN` env var). * All retraction actions log to `package_retraction_log` (slug, action, reason, actor, is\_operator, timestamp). * `GET /download/:slug/:version` now returns HTTP 410 for `withdrawn` or `quarantined` packages. * New `GET /v1/installed-status?slugs=A,B,C` endpoint for substrate-side polling per spec §11.9. **M9 — Download stats** * `package_downloads` table (slug, version, day, downloads counter), date-partitioned for archival. * View `v_popularity` for rolling 30-day per-package totals. * Async `bumpDownload()` on every (catalog still small; will swap to Typesense at >1k packages). * Searches across slug, description, owner. * Excludes withdrawn/quarantined packages by default (only returns `retracted = 'active'`). * Empty query returns most-recently-updated packages. Files touched in round 3: * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/sql/002-retraction-and-stats.sql` — new migration * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/db.ts` — applyRetraction, bumpDownload, getDownloadStats, getPackageState, listInstalledStatus, getMarketplaceSql exported * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/server.ts` — 9 new endpoints, retraction guard on /download/, async stats counter Verified end-to-end: * Deprecate/yank/withdraw all log to audit table ✓ * Quarantine requires operator token (401 without; 200 with) ✓ * Withdrawn package returns 410 on /download/ ✓ * Substrate poll endpoint returns retraction state for installed slugs ✓ * 4 downloads of signed-test correctly counted in stats ✓ * Search for “sign” finds signed-test; “paper” finds papercup-org ✓ * Production API responds 200 on all new endpoints ✓ ### What landed in round 2 (M2.5 + M5 + M7) [Section titled “What landed in round 2 (M2.5 + M5 + M7)”](#what-landed-in-round-2-m25--m5--m7) **M2.5 — Postgres metadata schema (dual-write)** * New schema `papercusp_marketplace` in `papercusp` DB (migration at `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/sql/001-marketplace-schema.sql`). * Tables: `packages` (slug + owner + retracted state), `package_versions` (manifest + signature + tier breakdown + tarball metadata). * Trigger maintains `updated_at` on package mutations. * marketplace-api dual-writes on every successful publish (FS still source of truth during this rollout). * Backfill script (`npm run backfill`) populates DB from existing FS state; idempotent for re-runs. * All 3 existing packages (papercup-coding, papercup-org, signed-test) backfilled successfully. **M5 — Update / uninstall / rollback CLI** * New state file at `~/.papercusp/installed-plugins.json` tracking each install: slug, version, install path, applied migration index, granted capabilities, manifest snapshot. * `papercusp install` now records into this state on success. * `papercusp update <slug> [--yes]`: * Fetches latest from registry; no-op if up to date. * Diffs capabilities (added / removed) and reports. * Snapshots old version to `~/.papercusp/snapshots/<slug>/<old-version>/` (full files dir + manifest + granted-caps.json). * Re-installs the new version atomically. * Records new state. * `papercusp uninstall <slug> [--purge-data]`: * Default: removes plugin code + state, **preserves Postgres data**. * `--purge-data`: also flags schema for cleanup (manual review since manifest doesn’t yet declare a schema name). * `papercusp rollback <slug>`: * Re-mounts most recent snapshot. * Updates state to reflect rolled-back version. * Surfaces “DB rollback is your responsibility” warning per spec §11.7. **M7 — Detail page rich UX** * Site: `/marketplace/[slug]/` now surfaces: * **Verified (signed) / Unverified badge** — green if signature present, amber otherwise. * **Install shape badge** (Iterative / Scheduled / Reactive / Passive) when `manifest.shape` set, with tooltip explaining the shape. * **Capability tier breakdown** — colored counts (high / medium / low), expandable to see all caps. * **Service ABI pins** sidebar when `manifest.services` set. * **publishedBy** linked to GitHub profile when stamped. * **publishedAt** human-readable. * **Signature provenance** sidebar with algo + sha256 + signed-by. * Helper `tierCapabilities()` and `SHAPE_LABEL` constants in `lib/format.ts` shared with the catalog grid for future filters. * Built + deployed to Cloudflare Pages (deployment `0aba4673`) — verified the new strings are in the JS chunks served from `papercuspai.com`. Files touched in round 2: * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/sql/001-marketplace-schema.sql` — new migration * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/db.ts` — new postgres-js client + upsertPackageVersion + categorizeCapabilities * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/server.ts` — dual-write call in publish handler * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/backfill.ts` — new one-time backfill script * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/package.json` — added `postgres` dep + `backfill` script * `libs/papercusp/packages/cli/src/papercusp.ts` — installed-plugins state, update/rollback commands, uninstall expansion, help text * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-site/lib/api.ts` — new types for shape / capabilities / services / signature * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-site/lib/format.ts` — tierCapabilities helper + SHAPE\_LABEL * `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-site/app/marketplace/[slug]/PackageClient.tsx` — new badges + sidebar sections ### Suggested phase ordering [Section titled “Suggested phase ordering”](#suggested-phase-ordering) Not all phases are equal priority. Here’s the order I’d run them in, by what unblocks the most usage: 1. **M1 (auth)** — block until landed; everything downstream assumes verified identities. 2. **M2 + M2.5 (R2 + Postgres metadata)** — durability + scale; necessary before significant publishing. 3. **M3 (tarball signing)** — supply chain integrity; prerequisite for verified-tier display. 4. **M7 (detail page UX)** — surface what M1+M3 enable to users. 5. **M5 (update/uninstall)** — close the install loop; users need this before they install anything important. 6. **M10 (quotas)** — anti-abuse before the marketplace is opened publicly. 7. **M6 (retraction)** — operational maturity; needed before a real security incident. 8. **M11 (webhooks)** — unlocks ecosystem integrations. 9. **M4 (search)** — only needed once catalog > \~100 packages. 10. **M9 (stats)** — nice-to-have signal; not blocking. 11. **M8 (reviews)** — community feature; needs moderation tooling. 12. **M12 (vendored)** — enterprise / air-gapped customers. 13. **M13 (multi-registry)** — corporate mirrors with public fallback. 14. **M14 (SBOMs)** — supply chain compliance; v2.0-shaped feature. ## Operational notes [Section titled “Operational notes”](#operational-notes) ### First-party seed templates (re-publishing) [Section titled “First-party seed templates (re-publishing)”](#first-party-seed-templates-re-publishing) The bundled templates `papercup-coding` and `papercup-org` are **first-party** — they’re owned by `@papercupai`, not by whoever happens to run the seed script. Their canonical source-of-truth lives in the marketplace repo at `../papercusp-registry/seeds/papercupai/<slug>/`. They’re published via the **same publish pipeline as any user package** — no SQL backfill, no special case in the server. Two auth modes cover this: **Service token (recommended for CI / seed scripts):** A static bearer token bound to a publisher login. The marketplace operator issues it via `PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_SERVICE_TOKENS` env (JSON array of `{token, login}` entries). Then: 
```bash
PAPERCUSP_SERVICE_TOKEN=<your-token> \
PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_URL=http://localhost:3057 \
  papercusp publish     # from inside seeds/papercupai/<slug>/
```
 The CLI sends the token as `Authorization: Bearer ...`; the server matches it against the configured table and stamps `publishedBy` from the bound login. No OAuth round-trip, no browser, fully scriptable. **OAuth Device Flow (for human publishing as @papercupai):** `papercusp login` then `papercusp publish`. Requires the @papercupai GitHub account/org to exist and you to be able to authenticate as it. **Don’t** insert seed packages directly via SQL or backfill scripts — that bypasses the publish pipeline (signing, indexing, webhook events) and creates orphan-attribution problems. The seeds README at `../papercusp-registry/seeds/README.md` documents the policy. ### Local development [Section titled “Local development”](#local-development) The marketplace-api runs as a systemd —user transient unit named `marketplace-api`, defined at `~/.config/systemd/user/marketplace-api.service`. It’s started automatically alongside `bin/dev` and survives shell exits. 
```bash
# Status / restart / logs
systemctl --user status marketplace-api
systemctl --user restart marketplace-api
journalctl --user -u marketplace-api -f
# or: tail -f ~/.papercusp/logs/marketplace-api.log


# Manual run (if you need to iterate without the unit):
cd ../papercusp-registry && npm run dev:api      # listens on :3057


# Build + serve site locally
cd ../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-site
BUILD_API_BASE=http://localhost:3057 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE=https://api.papercuspai.com npm run build
npx serve out -l 3060        # http://localhost:3060
```
 ### Production deploy [Section titled “Production deploy”](#production-deploy) 
```bash
cd libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-site
BUILD_API_BASE=http://localhost:3057 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE=https://api.papercuspai.com npm run build
npx wrangler pages deploy ./out --project-name papercuspai --branch main --commit-dirty=true
```
 The marketplace-api process must be running on `localhost:3057` for the build’s `generateStaticParams` step (which fetches the catalog to pre-render `/marketplace/[slug]/` pages). After M2 lands, this becomes optional — Postgres metadata can serve build-time too. ### Cloudflare touchpoints [Section titled “Cloudflare touchpoints”](#cloudflare-touchpoints) * **Pages project:** `papercuspai` (domain attached, deploys via wrangler) * **Tunnel:** `papercupai-api` (UUID `c53515b3-edfe-4e99-813b-e3916ae9d02c`) — same tunnel as papercupai.com, with two ingress rules (one per hostname) * **DNS apex:** `papercuspai.com` → `papercuspai.pages.dev` (CNAME, proxied) * **DNS api:** `api.papercuspai.com` → tunnel UUID via Zero Trust dashboard ### Known operational gotchas [Section titled “Known operational gotchas”](#known-operational-gotchas) * New publishes appear instantly in `/marketplace/` grid (live API fetch) but **404 on `[slug]` detail until site is rebuilt + redeployed** (`dynamicParams = false` on the static export). Future option: add an SSR fallback at the edge for unknown slugs. * The CF token at `~/.cloudflare-token` has Pages and a few zone scopes but **NOT** `Account · Cloudflare Tunnel · Edit`. Tunnel changes require dashboard clicks today. * `cloudflared` runs in token mode → ingress rules managed via Zero Trust dashboard, not `~/.cloudflared/config.yml`. * Marketplace dirs were moved on 2026-04-27 from `libs/papercusp/apps/{marketplace-api,marketplace-site}` → `../papercusp-registry/apps/{marketplace-api,marketplace-site}`. If you see stale paths anywhere, that’s why. * The `papercusp` CLI (`libs/papercusp/packages/cli/src/papercusp.ts`) lives in the **substrate** repo, not the marketplace repo. It talks to the marketplace via HTTP, so the split makes sense — but if you change the api shape on the server side, update the CLI in lockstep across both repos. ## Handoff — detailed implementation specs for remaining phases [Section titled “Handoff — detailed implementation specs for remaining phases”](#handoff--detailed-implementation-specs-for-remaining-phases) This section is the precise roadmap for the **3 remaining phases** if a future agent picks up. Each phase has been spec’d in §11 and partially designed earlier; here’s what an implementer needs to actually ship them. ### M2 — R2 storage backing (3-4h, **blocked on CF token scope**) [Section titled “M2 — R2 storage backing (3-4h, blocked on CF token scope)”](#m2--r2-storage-backing-3-4h-blocked-on-cf-token-scope) **Why it’s blocked:** Need a CF API token with `Account · R2 · Edit` to create the bucket and obtain S3-compatible credentials. The current `~/.cloudflare-token` has Pages + selected zone scopes only. **Plan once unblocked:** 1. Create R2 bucket `papercusp-marketplace-tarballs` (CF dashboard or API): 
   ```plaintext
   curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/f896982ea2f6d507e4f29eeecbd26e94/r2/buckets" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_R2_TOKEN" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"name":"papercusp-marketplace-tarballs"}'
   ```
 2. Get S3-compatible access keys (CF dashboard → R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens). Add to `~/.papercusp/marketplace-secrets.env`: 
   ```plaintext
   R2_ACCOUNT_ID=f896982ea2f6d507e4f29eeecbd26e94
   R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
   R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
   R2_BUCKET=papercusp-marketplace-tarballs
   ```
 3. Add `@aws-sdk/client-s3` to `../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-api/package.json`: 
   ```json
   "dependencies": {
     "@aws-sdk/client-s3": "^3.700.0",
     "@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner": "^3.700.0"
   }
   ```
 4. Create `../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-api/src/r2.ts`: * `S3Client` configured with `endpoint: https://${R2_ACCOUNT_ID}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`, `region: 'auto'` * `uploadTarball(slug, version, buf)` → `s3.send(new PutObjectCommand(...))` * `getDownloadUrl(slug, version)` → `getSignedUrl(s3, new GetObjectCommand(...), { expiresIn: 300 })` * Key format: `tarballs/${slug}/${version}/${slug}-${version}.tar.gz` 5. Modify `server.ts` publish handler: * After existing FS write to `tarballPath`, also call `uploadTarball(slug, version, buf)` * Continue dual-writing FS for now (rollback safety) 6. Modify `server.ts` `/download/:slug/:version`: * First try the R2 signed URL: redirect 302 to it * On any error (R2 down or migration not complete), fall back to existing FS stream * `papercusp_marketplace.package_versions.tarball_r2_key` column tracks if uploaded — add a migration 7. Migration script: `../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-api/src/migrate-to-r2.ts` — iterates existing FS packages, uploads each to R2, marks `tarball_r2_key` in the DB. 8. Delete FS storage AFTER verifying R2 + signed URLs serve correctly for a week. **Schema delta (002b):** 
```sql
ALTER TABLE papercusp_marketplace.package_versions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tarball_r2_key TEXT;
```
 **Testing:** * Unit: upload + signed URL roundtrip * Integration: publish via CLI, verify install pulls from R2 (302 redirect chain visible) * Failure mode: simulate R2 outage with bad credentials, verify FS fallback engages ### M8 — Author profiles + reviews (4-5h) [Section titled “M8 — Author profiles + reviews (4-5h)”](#m8--author-profiles--reviews-4-5h) **Schema** (003b-reviews.sql in `../papercusp-registry/sql/`): 
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS papercusp_marketplace.reviews (
  id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                  -- 'rv_' + 24 hex
  slug          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES papercusp_marketplace.packages(slug) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  reviewer      TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- verified GitHub login
  rating        SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(body) BETWEEN 10 AND 5000),
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  hidden_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,                       -- non-null = operator hid
  hidden_reason TEXT,
  UNIQUE (slug, reviewer)                          -- one review per user per package
);


CREATE INDEX reviews_slug_idx ON papercusp_marketplace.reviews(slug);
CREATE INDEX reviews_reviewer_idx ON papercusp_marketplace.reviews(reviewer);


GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON papercusp_marketplace.reviews TO harness_app, harness_admin;
```
 **Endpoints in `server.ts`:** * `GET /v1/packages/:slug/reviews` — list reviews (excludes hidden\_at IS NOT NULL); 50 most recent * `POST /v1/packages/:slug/reviews` — auth-required, insert/update by `(slug, reviewer)`. Reject if reviewer is the package’s `publishedBy` (no self-reviews). Reject if account < 7 days old (anti-spam). * `DELETE /v1/packages/:slug/reviews/:id` — owner of the review only * `POST /v1/admin/reviews/:id/hide` — operator-only; sets `hidden_at` + `hidden_reason` * `GET /v1/authors/:login` — public profile + their packages + their reviews (last 10) **Site changes** (`../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-site/`): * New page `/authors/[login]/page.tsx` with `generateStaticParams` from `package_versions.published_by DISTINCT` * New section on `/marketplace/[slug]/` (PackageClient.tsx) with reviews list + write-review form (auth-gated) * Average rating badge on the catalog grid **Anti-abuse rules** (per spec §8 of M8 plan): * Reviewers from accounts < 7 days old: visible but flagged “new account” * Reviews can be reported via `POST /v1/packages/:slug/reviews/:id/report` * Operator UI later (deferred) for moderation queue ### M14 — SBOM attestation + CVE scanning (6-8h) [Section titled “M14 — SBOM attestation + CVE scanning (6-8h)”](#m14--sbom-attestation--cve-scanning-6-8h) **Schema** (005-attestations.sql): 
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS papercusp_marketplace.package_attestations (
  slug              TEXT NOT NULL,
  version           TEXT NOT NULL,
  format            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (format IN ('spdx', 'cyclonedx')),
  sbom_json         JSONB NOT NULL,
  scanned_at        TIMESTAMPTZ,
  vulnerabilities   JSONB,                         -- [{ purl, advisory_id, severity, fixedIn }]
  PRIMARY KEY (slug, version),
  FOREIGN KEY (slug, version) REFERENCES papercusp_marketplace.package_versions(slug, version) ON DELETE CASCADE
);


CREATE INDEX attestations_unscanned_idx
  ON papercusp_marketplace.package_attestations(scanned_at) WHERE scanned_at IS NULL;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON papercusp_marketplace.package_attestations TO harness_app, harness_admin;
```
 **Publish handler change:** * `POST /publish/:slug/:version` accepts an additional multipart field `sbom` (JSON file). Validate against the format’s JSON schema before storing. If valid, insert into `package_attestations` with `scanned_at = NULL`. **Scan worker** (`../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-api/src/sbom-scanner.ts`): * Long-lived loop (1-min tick) drains rows where `scanned_at IS NULL` * For each: extract package list (SPDX `packages[]` or CycloneDX `components[]`) * For each package: query `https://api.osv.dev/v1/query` with PURL or CPE * Store findings in `vulnerabilities[]` * Re-scan all attestations weekly (set `scanned_at = NULL` for rows older than 7d) * Rate limit: max 10 osv.dev queries/sec; back off on 429 **Endpoints:** * `GET /v1/packages/:slug/:version/sbom` — raw SBOM JSON * `GET /v1/packages/:slug/:version/sbom/viewer` — formatted HTML (server-side render via marked.js or similar) * `GET /v1/packages/:slug/:version/vulnerabilities` — current findings **Site changes:** * “Has SBOM” badge on detail page (already wired UI: just add a check) * Vulnerability count badge if `vulnerabilities.length > 0` * Optional: SBOM diff between two versions (deferred to v2) **CLI:** * `papercusp publish --sbom ./sbom.spdx.json` — multipart upload * `papercusp install` warns if installed plugin has unpatched CVEs (queries `/v1/packages/:slug/:version/vulnerabilities` after install) ### Smaller cleanup items [Section titled “Smaller cleanup items”](#smaller-cleanup-items) * **Reviews UI** — see M8 above; deferred until M8 is in progress. * **Spec docs site relocation** — the spec is now embedded as the Fumadocs `(docs)` route group inside `apps/papercusp` (served at `localhost:3055/docs`). After v1.0 freeze, consider moving the `content/docs/` source to `Papercusp/papercusp` so it travels with the substrate. (The legacy Starlight version at `apps/papercusp-spec/` remains in the tree but is no longer the canonical site.) * **`apps/papercusp-marketplace`** in the internal reference app’s old workspace exclusions — verify `package.json` workspaces still ignore it (the dir is gone, but the negation is harmless). * **OAuth secret rotation** — pasted in chat 2026-04-27. Status: probably still original secret. Rotate at github.com → Developer Settings → “Papercusp Marketplace” → Generate new client secret → update `~/.papercusp/marketplace-secrets.env` line `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=...` → restart marketplace-api. ## Quick-start for a future agent [Section titled “Quick-start for a future agent”](#quick-start-for-a-future-agent) If you’re picking this up cold, here’s the 5-minute orientation: 1. **Where the code lives**: * Substrate: `Papercusp/papercusp` repo → submodule at `<reference-app>/libs/papercusp/` * Marketplace: `Papercusp/papercusp-registry` repo → submodule at `<reference-app>/../papercusp-registry/` * Spec docs: embedded in `<reference-app>/apps/papercusp/content/docs/` and served at `localhost:3055/docs` (Fumadocs). Legacy Starlight source still in `<reference-app>/apps/papercusp-spec/`. * Substrate UI: `libs/papercusp/apps/web/` (lives at `localhost:3055`) * CLI: `libs/papercusp/packages/cli/src/papercusp.ts` 2. **How to start everything**: 
   ```bash
   cd ~/reference-app
   # marketplace-api (port 3057):
   bash -c 'set -a; source $HOME/.papercusp/marketplace-secrets.env; set +a; nohup npm run dev:marketplace > /tmp/marketplace-api.log 2>&1 &'
   # spec docs are now served by apps/papercusp at /docs (no separate process):
   #   already running at http://localhost:3055/docs once papercusp dev is up
   # admin web (port 3001):
   cd apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web && PORT=3001 HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 nohup node server.js > /tmp/web-prod.log 2>&1 &
   # substrate web (port 3055):
   cd ~/reference-app && nohup npm run dev:papercusp > /tmp/papercusp-web.log 2>&1 &
   ```
 3. **How to verify everything is up**: 
   ```bash
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w ":3057 healthz: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3057/healthz
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w ":3055 substrate UI: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3055/
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w ":3001 admin: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3001/
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w ":3055 docs: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3055/docs
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w "papercuspai.com: %{http_code}\n" https://papercuspai.com/
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w "api.papercuspai.com: %{http_code}\n" https://api.papercuspai.com/healthz
   ```
 4. **The Postgres state**: 
   ```sql
   -- in `papercusp` DB, schema `papercusp_marketplace`
   SELECT 'packages' AS t, COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.packages
   UNION ALL SELECT 'package_versions', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.package_versions
   UNION ALL SELECT 'package_downloads', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.package_downloads
   UNION ALL SELECT 'package_retraction_log', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.package_retraction_log
   UNION ALL SELECT 'sessions', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.sessions
   UNION ALL SELECT 'webhook_subscriptions', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.webhook_subscriptions
   UNION ALL SELECT 'webhook_deliveries', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.webhook_deliveries;
   ```

# Multi-harness spawning / communication

> Plan to make harness-spawning + cross-harness coordination first-class substrate features. Auth-bound identity from day one; papercup-org is the first consumer, not a special case.

> **Webapp retired (2026-05-14).** Any `localhost:3055` or `localhost:3070` URL on this page is only reachable while the **Tauri dev shell** is running. Start it with `cd papercusp-desktop && npm run dev`. Shipped, then evolved — read this as the original plan The multi-harness substrate described here **did ship** and has since moved. Treat the inline file paths below as the plan’s original targets, not current locations: * `POST /api/admin/execute-action` lives in **`packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/routes/admin/execute-action.ts`** (Hono), alongside `rotate-token.ts` and `prune-executed-actions.ts`. Cross-harness reads are under **`packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/routes/cross-harness/`**. * The per-harness `config_token` design was later **retired** (migration `121-retire-per-harness-config-token-and-proposals.sql`); token identity was reworked. The orchestrator-emitted spawning is now the `fleet:*` / cross-harness substrate (`packages/operator-core/lib/fleet/operator-spawn.ts`). * The orchestrator the plan refers to (`run.sh` → TS) was ported and its run-loop later retired; see [orchestrator-port](/internal/docs/implementation/orchestrator-port). * **Completion-reporting moved engine entirely.** It no longer runs through the `run.sh` `afterDone.sh` bash builtin (run.sh itself is gone, so the bash `run_hook` / builtins resolver the body describes in Step 4.5 no longer exists). It is now the DBOS TS builtin **`packages/operator-core/lib/dbos/notify-parent-done.ts`**, which fires on per-feature-queue drain (a feature’s DONE finalize, only when no other non-terminal feature remains) and reads the server-sealed `parent_slug` from `harness_shared.projects` (PG) — **not** from `.papercusp/config.json`, which is deprecated as a live config source. A per-harness `hooks/afterDone.sh` still overrides the builtin. (promote-spawn-child-harness-2026-05-31; deprecate-harness-config-json-2026-06-06.) * **Several §3/§10 non-goals later shipped** in `packages/operator-core/lib/execute-action.ts`: per-caller `send_message` rate limiting (`PAPERCUSP_SEND_MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT`, default 50 per 60s), spawn cycle + depth detection (`PAPERCUSP_MAX_SPAWN_DEPTH`, default 8, walking the `parent_slug` chain), and `dryRun: true` on `scaffold_harness` (validate-only — no shell-out, no FS writes). Read the §3/§10 entries for these as plan-time scope, not current state. * **The executeAction dispatcher grew past the four planned verbs.** `dispatchAction` in `packages/operator-core/lib/execute-action.ts` now implements nine verbs — beyond `send_message` / `mark_message_status` / `spinup_project` / `scaffold_harness` it also handles `create_feature`, `pause_project`, `resume_project`, `mark_campaign_published`, and `add_directive_summary` (several of which §3 lists as non-goals). * **API host is `:3070`, not `:3055`.** The Tier 3 curl examples (Step 3c) and the agent-facing snippets point at `:3055`, which is only the Vite SPA dev server (it proxies `/api → :3070` in dev and is absent on the release operator). The real Hono API host that serves `/api/admin/execute-action` and the read endpoints is `:3070` (`PAPERCUSP_HONO_PORT`); internal / loopback calls must target it. See `packages/operator-core/lib/operator-api-base.ts`. ## 1. Goal [Section titled “1. Goal”](#1-goal) Make harness-spawning and cross-harness coordination first-class capabilities of the standard harness substrate, with auth-bound identity from day one. Concretely: * Any harness whose role config declares `allowedActions: [..., "scaffold_harness"]` can spawn children. * Any marketplace template that declares `spawnable: { kind, requires }` can be spawned as a child. * Children whose `parent_slug` is set automatically report completion back to their parent — no per-template hook authoring required. * Every orchestrator understands it’s running inside Papercusp, can see its parent / children / siblings at a glance, and can pull full state of any other harness on demand via authenticated read APIs. * Any harness whose role config grants `send_message` can message any other harness, with a declared `reason` recorded in the audit log. * **Every executeAction call is authenticated against a per-harness shared-secret token; harness identity is derived from the token binding, not from caller-supplied body fields. `parent_slug` and message `from_slug` are derived (not trusted), so spoofing is impossible at the protocol level.** * The `papercup-org` template is the first template that uses these features, not a special case. The user-facing demo: drop a directive into the `papercup-org` parent’s inbox, manually invoke its director, watch it spawn children with full context of the org, watch them run while the parent can intervene mid-mission, watch completion flow back. ## 2. Scope [Section titled “2. Scope”](#2-scope) Closed-loop manual demo via standard substrate. End-to-end smokes must pass: * **Smoke A** — papercup-org happy path (directive → spawn → first non-trivial file → completion message in parent inbox) * **Smoke B** — generic non-`papercup-org` harness can also spawn children (proves the feature is substrate, not template-specific) * **Smoke C** — neighbor visibility works (a child’s prompt sees its parent’s status; a parent’s prompt sees its children’s statuses; cross-harness supervisor message arrives in child’s prompt-build) * **Smoke D** — auth model holds: a request without a valid token, with a token bound to harness X claiming to be harness Y, or with a forged `callingHarness` body field, is rejected with 401/403 Autonomy (routine ticker, coordinator dispatch, auditor cadence) is a **separate plan** — not included here. ## 3. Non-goals [Section titled “3. Non-goals”](#3-non-goals) * Coordinator dispatch — `NEXT_HARNESS` parses but doesn’t fire children autonomously. * Auditor cadence — file exists, no scheduler invokes it. * `add_directive_summary` — context bounded by prompt-build truncation instead. * `mark_campaign_published`, `pause_project`, `resume_project` — useful, not needed for the loop. * Briefings plugin — gone, dropped from manifest until source is restored or rebuilt. * Many-directive scale, multi-week autonomy, KPI dashboards. * Cross-machine spawn (parent on machine A, child on machine B). * Spawn quotas / rate limiting per parent. * Permission tiers beyond `allowedActions[]` and the auth token. * Per-role addressing (`to: [<harness>:<role>]`); messages address harnesses, not roles within. * `dryRun: true` for `scaffold_harness` — defer to v1.5. * Cache-and-verify idempotency replay — v1 is cache-is-authoritative. * Token rotation for compromised harnesses — manual reissue only in v1. ## 4. Architecture decisions (locked before code) [Section titled “4. Architecture decisions (locked before code)”](#4-architecture-decisions-locked-before-code) ### Auth & identity [Section titled “Auth & identity”](#auth--identity) | Decision | Choice | Rationale | | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Per-harness shared secret | `harness_<slug>.config_token` (random 256-bit, base64url) generated at scaffold time, written to `.papercusp/config.json` mode 0600 | Cryptographic identity binding; token serves as both authn and authz | | Auth header | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every executeAction request | Standard, simple | | Identity derivation | Executor looks up token in `harness_shared.token_index` to find which harness slug owns it. **`callingHarness` in the request body is REJECTED if it doesn’t match the derived identity.** | Body fields are forgeable; token binding is not | | `parent_slug` sealing | `parent_slug = <derivedCallingHarness>` on `scaffold_harness`; never read from body | Real seal, not security theater | | `from_slug` on messages | Always = `<derivedCallingHarness>`; body’s `from` field rejected on mismatch | Stops cross-harness spoofing in the audit log | | Token rotation | Out of scope for v1; manual deletion of harness + re-scaffold if compromised | v1 is correctness-floor; rotation is hardening | ### Action execution [Section titled “Action execution”](#action-execution) | Decision | Choice | Rationale | | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Endpoint shape | Slug-less `POST /api/admin/execute-action` with `targetSlug` in action body | Many actions cross harnesses; URL-as-context is the wrong frame | | Verb dispatch | Single endpoint with `op` discriminator | Matches the deleted `org.ts` contract; matches `actions-block.ts`’s POST shape | | State backend | PG (per-harness `harness_<slug>.messages`, `harness_shared.projects`) | Universal Schema + Zero sync already in place | | Caller-supplied idempotency | `actionId` (UUID) supplied by caller; server returns same `result` on replay | Workers retry on flake; double-spinup is unrecoverable | | Idempotency replay semantics | **Cache-is-authoritative.** Cached response returned without verifying side effects still exist. | Documented as v1 boundary; out-of-band mutations break replay correctness; v1.5 can add cache-and-verify | | Per-action error shape | `{ok, actionId, error?, result?}`; ACTIONS array continues past mid-array failures | Matches `actions-block.ts` loop semantics | | Per-verb timeouts | `scaffold_harness`: 5 min. All other verbs: 60s. | Scaffold legitimately needs minutes (`papercusp init`, schema scaffold, etc.); the rest are SQL or fast | | `send_message` addressing | Any harness → any harness; receiver decides whether to consume via prompt-build | Open bus, gated by receiver | | `send_message` reason field | Required `reason: string` (min 10 chars; warn on placeholder regex but don’t block) | Friction filters trivial chatter | | `spinup_project` partial-failure semantics | Wrapped in a single PG transaction across all affected per-harness schemas. All-or-nothing. | Atomicity > diagnostic detail at v1 | | `scaffold_harness` slug uniqueness | `INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`; if conflict → 409 with `error: 'slug already in use'` | Don’t write to someone else’s schema | ### Parent / child structure [Section titled “Parent / child structure”](#parent--child-structure) | Decision | Choice | Rationale | | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Parent/child relationship | Optional `parent_slug` column on `harness_shared.projects`, mirrored to `.papercusp/config.json.parent_slug` | Structural fact at the registry level; substrate code reads it | | Completion-reporting hook | Default `afterDone.sh` ships in `libs/papercusp/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/` and fires when the harness has `parent_slug` set | One canonical impl, opt-in by config | | Hook resolution chain | `<harness-dir>/.papercusp/hooks/<name>.sh` → `<libs>/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/<name>.sh`. **Resolver scans `builtins/` generically; afterDone is the only v1 builtin shipped.** | New builtins (e.g. `onPostValidator.sh`) are then a one-file PR in v1.5+ | | User-supplied per-harness hook | Wins over builtin | Standard hook resolution; backward compatible | ### Marketplace contract [Section titled “Marketplace contract”](#marketplace-contract) | Decision | Choice | Rationale | | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- | | Template “spawnable” contract | New manifest field `spawnable: { kind: 'coding'\|'service'\|..., requires: [...] }` in `papercusp.json` | Marketplace knows which templates a director can pick from | | Spawnable-templates discovery | `GET /api/marketplace/spawnable` returns catalog filtered to `spawnable` entries | Director prompt builds available templates list at runtime | | `scaffold_harness` template validation | Executor rejects `template` not in spawnable catalog | Prevents directors from spawning marketing-only templates | | Adding `spawnable` to existing templates | Bumps patch version (`0.1.0` → `0.1.1`) and re-publishes; documented as the marketplace contract for “additive manifest field” | Avoids undefined-behavior on cached clients | ### Cross-harness visibility (tiered) [Section titled “Cross-harness visibility (tiered)”](#cross-harness-visibility-tiered) | Decision | Choice | Rationale | | ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Tier 1 — Substrate self-description | Every prompt includes a fixed ”## About Papercusp” preamble (\~300 tokens, identical across all harnesses) | Coherence: orchestrators understand they’re running inside a multi-harness framework | | Tier 2 — Neighbor view | Every prompt includes a depth-1 view of: parent (if any), children (if any), siblings sharing same `parent_slug` | Bounded growth, sufficient for relational coordination | | Tier 2 detail level | Parent: slug + recent activity 1-liner + last message between us. Children: slug + feature status counts + last activity ts + **`spawned_count: N`** for grandchild visibility hint. Siblings: slug + status counts. **Plus an aggregate roll-up.** | \~50 tokens each + \~20 tokens roll-up; prevents prompt bloat while flagging where Tier 3 inspection is warranted | | Tier 3 — Inspect-on-demand | Read APIs (`/api/harness/projects`, `/api/harness/<slug>/status`, `/api/harness/<slug>/inbox`, `/api/harness/all/recent-activity`) listed in prompt as “available capabilities”; agent invokes when relevant | Full visibility achievable; pay only when needed | | Tier 3 invocation mechanism | **Verified in Step 0.5** — either `Bash` is wired into `--allowed-tools` (so curl works), or a new MCP tool server `mcp__papercusp__inspectHarness({slug})` etc. ships in Step 2.5. **Without this, Tier 3 is dead text.** | Don’t promise Tier 3 in prompts the agent can’t act on | | Cross-harness inbox consumption | Each harness’s orchestrator/scoper/worker prompt-build includes its own bounded inbox; consumed messages auto-ack ONLY when orchestrator decision ∈ `{DONE, NEXT_*}`; `ESCALATE`/`REVIEW` leave pending | Parent → child mid-mission supervision reaches the agents; user-escalation messages aren’t eaten | ### Autonomy (deferred to v2 plan) [Section titled “Autonomy (deferred to v2 plan)”](#autonomy-deferred-to-v2-plan) | Decision | Choice | Rationale | | ------------------ | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Autonomy substrate | TBD pending Step 0 spike | Routine plugin if substrate is durable across operator restarts; otherwise PG-backed work queue or systemd timer | ## 5. Steps [Section titled “5. Steps”](#5-steps) ### Step 0 — Routine substrate spike *(\~30 min)* [Section titled “Step 0 — Routine substrate spike (\~30 min)”](#step-0--routine-substrate-spike-30-min) Read `libs/papercusp/packages/plugin-loader/src/routines.ts` (or wherever routines live) and answer: **Does the routine ticker survive operator process restart?** * If yes: commit to routine plugin for v2 autoLoop. * If no: pivot to `pending_events` table + a separate ticker process (systemd timer or sidecar daemon). **Output:** decision note in `docs/decisions/routine-durability.md`. **Gate:** none — informational only; this plan doesn’t depend on the answer. ### Step 0.5 — Action-body + auth contract *(\~2 hours)* [Section titled “Step 0.5 — Action-body + auth contract (\~2 hours)”](#step-05--action-body--auth-contract-2-hours) Single 2–3 page document at `apps/operator/app/api/_hono/execute-action.contract.md`: **Auth model:** * Per-harness token: 256-bit random, base64url, generated at scaffold time, stored at `.papercusp/config.json:harness_token` mode 0600 * Auth header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` required on every request * Identity derivation: server queries `harness_shared.token_index` to derive `<derivedCallingHarness>`; if no match → 401 * Body’s `callingHarness`: must equal `<derivedCallingHarness>` or be omitted; mismatch → 403 * Body’s `from` (in `send_message`): must equal `<derivedCallingHarness>`; mismatch → 403 * `parent_slug` (in `scaffold_harness`): NEVER body-controlled; always set by server to `<derivedCallingHarness>` **Tier 3 verification (the inspect\_harness capability):** * Confirm whether `claude -p` invocations from `run.sh` include `Bash` in `--allowed-tools`. * If yes: agent can curl Tier 3 endpoints directly. Step 2.5 is just docs. * If no: ship `mcp__papercusp__inspectHarness` MCP tools in Step 2.5 wrapping the read endpoints. * Document the chosen mechanism in this contract. **Endpoint:** * `POST /api/admin/execute-action` * Request body: 
  ```ts
  {
    actionId: string,        // UUID supplied by caller, idempotency key
    callingHarness?: string, // optional; must match Bearer-derived if present
    callingDept?: string,    // backwards-compat for run.sh (informational only)
    action: { op: '...', ... }
  }
  ```
 * Per-verb request fields: * `send_message`: `to[], kind, subject, body, parentMessageId?, reason: string` *(`from` derived)* * `mark_message_status`: `messageId, status: 'acknowledged' | 'archived'` * `spinup_project`: `directiveId, projectName, projectVertical, projectBudgetCents, departments[]` * `scaffold_harness`: `projectSlug, template, spec, goal` *(`parent_slug` derived)* * Response: `{ok, actionId, result?, error?}` * Idempotency: same `actionId` → cached response, no re-execution, no side-effect verification (cache-is-authoritative) * Error categories: `validation_error` (400), `auth_error` (401|403), `not_found` (404), `conflict` (409), `internal` (500) * Per-verb timeouts: `scaffold_harness` 5 min, others 60s **Gate:** committed to repo. ### Step 1 — PG schema migration *(\~1d)* [Section titled “Step 1 — PG schema migration (\~1d)”](#step-1--pg-schema-migration-1d) Update `bin/scaffold-harness-schema.sh` to add to every per-harness schema: 
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.config_token (
  token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.messages (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  from_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT,
  parent_message_id UUID,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  acknowledged_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'acknowledged', 'archived'))
);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.messages (status, created_at);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.messages (to_slug, status);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.messages (from_slug, created_at);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.supervisor_notes (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.executed_actions (
  action_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  op TEXT NOT NULL,
  caller_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_slug TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  request JSONB NOT NULL,
  response JSONB NOT NULL,
  executed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.executed_actions (caller_slug, executed_at);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.executed_actions (target_slug, executed_at);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.executed_actions (op, executed_at);
```
 And to `harness_shared`: 
```sql
ALTER TABLE harness_shared.projects
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_slug TEXT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_parent ON harness_shared.projects (parent_slug);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_shared.token_index (
  token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  harness_slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```
 **Idempotent migration script** `bin/migrate-installed-harnesses-add-messages.sh`: * For each row in `harness_shared.projects`: * If the project path doesn’t exist on disk → log “skip (orphaned registry row)” and continue * Else: provision new tables in `harness_<slug>` (idempotent via `IF NOT EXISTS`) * Generate a fresh token, write to `<project_path>/.papercusp/config.json` (chmod 0600), insert into both `harness_<slug>.config_token` and `harness_shared.token_index` * At end, print summary: `provisioned: N, skipped: M (broken rows), errors: K` **Verify:** apply against an existing harness; confirm tables; re-run; confirm idempotent. Apply against the 7 currently-broken `papercup-org*` rows; confirm “skipped: 7.” **Gate:** all installed harnesses (with valid project paths) have the new tables + tokens; broken rows logged but not failed. ### Step 2 — executeAction with 4 verbs + auth *(\~3.5d)* [Section titled “Step 2 — executeAction with 4 verbs + auth (\~3.5d)”](#step-2--executeaction-with-4-verbs--auth-35d) New file `apps/operator/app/api/admin/execute-action/route.ts`. **Auth middleware *(\~0.5d)*:** * Reject if no `Authorization: Bearer` header (401). * Look up bearer in `harness_shared.token_index`; if no match → 401. * Set `derivedCallingHarness = <slug from match>` on request context. * If body has `callingHarness` and it doesn’t match → 403 with clear error. * If verb is `send_message` and body has `from` and it doesn’t match → 403. * If verb is `scaffold_harness` and body has `parent_slug` → 400 (validation error). **Three SQL-only verbs *(\~1d)*:** * `send_message`: validate `reason` ≥ 10 chars; placeholder-regex match logs warning to `executed_actions.reason` but proceeds. INSERT into `harness_<to_slug>.messages` with `from_slug = <derivedCallingHarness>`. If `kind === 'Directive'`, also append to `harness_<to_slug>.supervisor_notes`. * `mark_message_status`: UPDATE `harness_<derivedCallingHarness>.messages` (only your own inbox/outbox is yours to mark) `SET status = $2, acknowledged_at = now() WHERE id = $1`. * `spinup_project`: opens a PG transaction across all affected schemas; INSERT into `harness_shared.projects`; for each requested department, recurse-in-process to fire follow-up `send_message` (kickoff/priority/budget) within the same transaction. Single COMMIT or single ROLLBACK. Returns `{subActions: [{actionId, op, ok}, ...]}` for diagnostic detail. **`scaffold_harness` *(\~1.75d)*:** * Validate `projectSlug`, `template`, `spec`, `goal`. * Look up `template` in the spawnable catalog. If not present or `spawnable` field absent, reject with `validation_error: 'template not spawnable'`. * Check slug uniqueness: query `harness_shared.projects WHERE slug = $1`. If exists → 409 `slug already in use`. * Shell out to `papercusp init <projectSlug> --from <template>` with **5-minute** timeout. * After init succeeds, atomically merge `parent_slug: <derivedCallingHarness>` into the new harness’s `.papercusp/config.json`. * Generate `harness_token`, write to the new harness’s `.papercusp/config.json` (chmod 0600). * Call internal harness-projects registration with `parent_slug` (which provisions the per-harness PG schema, including the new `config_token` + `token_index` rows). * On partial scaffold (init succeeded, register failed): error response includes the partially-created path so retry with same `actionId` cleans up + retries. Idempotency check on `executed_actions` short-circuits before any FS work. * On `papercusp init` failure: rollback any partial directory creation, return `internal` error with stderr. * On 5-min timeout: SIGTERM → SIGKILL → rollback, return `internal` error with `timeout: true`. **Idempotency wrapper *(\~0.25d)*:** 
```ts
const cached = await getExecutedAction(actionId, callerSlug);
if (cached) return cached.response;  // cache-is-authoritative; documented
const result = await dispatch(action);
await saveExecutedAction({
  actionId, op: action.op, callerSlug: derivedCallingHarness,
  targetSlug: extractTargetSlug(action), reason: action.reason ?? null,
  request: action, response: result,
});
return result;
```
 Verify each verb individually with curl (using a real bearer token), including auth-failure paths; commit each verb as its own commit. **Gate:** all four verbs return 200 on happy path + 4xx on validation failures + 401/403 on auth failures + 409 on slug conflicts + idempotent on `actionId` replay. ### Step 2.5 — Verify or wire the `inspect_harness` capability *(\~0.5d)* [Section titled “Step 2.5 — Verify or wire the inspect\_harness capability (\~0.5d)”](#step-25--verify-or-wire-the-inspect_harness-capability-05d) Outcome from Step 0.5 verification dictates this step: * **If `Bash` is already in `--allowed-tools`:** validate that an agent can curl `localhost:3055/api/harness/projects` from inside a tool call. Document the curl pattern in the prompt-build’s “Available capabilities” section. \~0.25d. * **If not:** ship a new MCP tool server at `apps/operator/lib/inspect-harness-mcp-server.mjs` exposing tools `inspectHarness({slug})`, `listProjects({})`, `recentActivity({limit})`. Wire into the `claude -p` invocation in run.sh’s per-role spawn. Document the tool names in the prompt-build’s “Available capabilities” section. \~0.5d. **Gate:** an agent invoked with the new prompt CAN actually invoke an inspect call and receive a response. ## About Papercusp


```markdown
You are an agent inside a Papercusp harness — an autonomous-harness framework
where role-based agent crews ("harnesses") build features.


- Each harness has a SPEC, a feature backlog, and a role crew (orchestrator,
  scoper, worker, validator, ...). Yours is below.
- Harnesses can have a parent and/or children, related via `parent_slug`.
  Yours is shown below.
- Harnesses can message each other via the `send_message` action (gated by

- The substrate is the same for every harness — yours and everyone else's.
- You can inspect any other harness on demand via the read APIs listed in
  "Available capabilities" below.
```

 Caution **Host drift:** the `localhost:3055` in these examples is the plan’s original target. Token count: less than 2k tokens of substrate framing for an org with 7 harnesses + 6 children visible. ### Step 4 — Retarget callers *(\~0.5d)* [Section titled “Step 4 — Retarget callers (\~0.5d)”](#step-4--retarget-callers-05d) `libs/papercusp/packages/orchestrator/src/actions-block.ts`: * Default `apiUrl` from env `PAPERCUSP_OPERATOR_BASE` (default `http://localhost:3055`). * Endpoint: `/api/admin/execute-action` (slug-less per locked decision). * Body includes `actionId: randomUUID()`.
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Built-in: notify parent harness on mission completion.
# Fires only when this harness has parent_slug set in .papercusp/config.json.
# User-supplied .papercusp/hooks/afterDone.sh overrides this entirely.
set -e
PARENT_SLUG="$(jq -r '.parent_slug // empty' .papercusp/config.json 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$PARENT_SLUG" ] && exit 0  # no parent, silent success


TOKEN="$(jq -r '.harness_token // empty' .papercusp/config.json 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$TOKEN" ] && { echo "afterDone: no harness_token in config; skipping" >&2; exit 0; }


SELF_SLUG="$(jq -r '.slug // empty' .papercusp/config.json 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$SELF_SLUG" ] && SELF_SLUG="$(basename "$PWD")"


ACTION_ID="$(uuidgen)"
BASE="${PAPERCUSP_OPERATOR_BASE:-http://localhost:3055}"


curl -sS --max-time 30 -X POST "$BASE/api/admin/execute-action" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d "$(jq -nc \
    --arg id "$ACTION_ID" \
    --arg to "$PARENT_SLUG" \
    '{actionId: $id, action: {op: "send_message", to: [$to], kind: "Completion", subject: "mission DONE", body: "", reason: "afterDone substrate hook: notifying parent of mission completion"}}')" \
  > /dev/null
```
 Update `run.sh`’s `run_hook` to scan `${HARNESS_LIB_DIR}/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/` for any matching `<name>.sh` and fall through when no per-harness override exists. Generic resolver, ship one builtin (`afterDone`) for v1. **Gate:** seed `parent_slug` + `harness_token` in a test harness’s config.json, run a short mission to DONE, verify the parent’s `harness_<parent>.messages` table has the Completion row with `from_slug = <child-slug>`. ### Step 4.6 — Bounded inbox in coding-harness prompt-build *(\~0.5d)* [Section titled “Step 4.6 — Bounded inbox in coding-harness prompt-build (\~0.5d)”](#step-46--bounded-inbox-in-coding-harness-prompt-build-05d) Update prompt-build for orchestrator, scoper, and worker so each iteration’s prompt includes:

 Drawn from `harness_<self>.messages WHERE to_slug = <self> AND status = 'pending' AND from_slug = <parent_slug> ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5`. **Auto-acknowledge scoping:** at end of iteration, if orchestrator decision ∈ `{DONE, NEXT_WORKER, NEXT_VALIDATOR, NEXT_ARCHITECT, NEXT_HARNESS, ...}` (the “happy progression” verbs), mark consumed messages as `acknowledged`. If decision ∈ `{ESCALATE, REVIEW, FEATURE_FREEZE}` or iteration fails non-zero, leave messages pending so the next iteration (after user intervention) sees them again. **Gate:** drop a `send_message` from a parent harness to a running child; the child’s next iteration’s prompt includes it; after the iteration completes with `NEXT_WORKER`, the message status flips to `acknowledged`. Repeat with an iteration that `ESCALATE`s; verify message remains pending. ### Step 5a — Re-bundle the papercup-org template *(\~0.75d)* [Section titled “Step 5a — Re-bundle the papercup-org template (\~0.75d)”](#step-5a--re-bundle-the-papercup-org-template-075d) Build the missing `parent/` directory:

```plaintext
1. Reset state: prune any existing papercup-org* rows + delete project dirs.
2. Reinstall: papercusp install papercup-org.
3. Drop directive into parent inbox via curl POST /api/harness/papercup-org/messages,

   hasSpec=true, parent_slug=papercup-org.

   --max-iterations 10.

    OR reaches DONE — whichever comes first, max 5 min.
11. Assert: builtin afterDone hook fired (only if DONE was reached) — executed_actions
    has a send_message op with from_slug=<child-slug>, kind='Completion', reason populated.
12. Assert: parent's GET /inbox shows the Completion message at status='pending'
    (or, if step 10 stopped at "first file written," assert that the child has a real
    file on disk — proves the spawn produced a working harness even if it didn't
    fully complete).
```
